title: Anthropic's ant CLI: 10 Minutes to a Live Claude Agent
description:
Anthropic's ant CLI dropped a month ago — and most devs still haven't tried it. It's the command-line tool for deploying Claude managed agents in YAML, kubectl-style.

Install with one brew command. Define your agent as a YAML file — name, model, system prompt, tool block — check it into git like any other config. The full ant beta:agents create command fits on one line. That's a working code reviewer with no app code, no runtime to host, and no scaling tickets.

The pricing nobody talks about: $0.08 per session-hour, billed to the millisecond. A typical one-hour Opus session lands around 70 cents end-to-end. MCP servers plug in if you need custom tools.

Ten minutes from brew install to a deployed agent.

🔗 Full hands-on walkthrough: https://avinashsangle.com/blog/ant-cli-getting-started
